injury.shortComment: Santos (knee) is questionable for Friday's game against the Lakers.
injury.detail: After being listed as doubtful, Santos now has a better chance of playing Friday. He could test out his knee during pregame warmups before the Warriors come to a final decision.

injury.shortComment: Ighodaro (oblique) is listed as questionable for Friday's game against Denver.
injury.detail: Ighodaro hasn't played since Phoenix's regular-season opener due to a right oblique strain, though he's considered day-to-day ahead of Friday's contest. If the big man is cleared to return, Khaman Maluach and Duop Reath could see fewer minutes.
